verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports multi-item work indirectly. It can query and edit large codebases, span several directories with --include-directories, and run non-interactively in scripts with JSON output, so users can loop it over many items. The GitHub integration also automates issue triage and labeling across issues. A community user reports it handled very large codebases well, but the evidence shows no dedicated bulk or batch operation primitive. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party batch/bulk operation feature, documentation of applying one change across many items at once, and hands-on corroboration of bulk edits.
